title: 天皇賞（春）の後に・緊急コード

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huff… Puff… Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Brian… really is… as fast as a jet!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What the hell?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Why… can I still not…

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hmph. It's like I'm not even on her radar.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Just what the heck is she looking a—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: …Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: What is Brian looking at?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer? Can I ask you for something?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Please let me race against Brian one more time. As soon as possible.
choice_data_list: You still want to challenge her?
You still want to challenge her?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I'm not really sure why, but I know I have to…

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Not just that. This time, I feel like I should do it as soon as possible…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Mayano… You felt that in today's race?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I see. Then I guess I've gotta tell ya.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen is your last chance.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Brian's decided the Arima will be her last race before she quits running.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Tch… It's still too early for her to quit!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hishiama?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: But… why? That doesn't make any sense.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: It doesn't have to be her last race… She was incredible today.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Running against her got me so excited again.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I can't let it end like this… I won't accept it!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I don't want it to end on a loss!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: …Yeah, I do. More than anything else.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Next time, I'll make sure she's the one trembling with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Some racers are so twinkly the audience can't even see the other racers. They get everyone excited.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I wanna become a racer that can excite her like that!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hishiama said that Brian's last race will be the Arima Kinen, right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: That means you have until the Arima Kinen to train me to perfection.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Thank you. Ehehe, I can't wait.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She sets her sights on the Arima Kinen—a race against the incredible opponent she so wishes to excite. That means we need to get her on the G1 agenda.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She has a chance this summer and another one in autumn. She either has to run in a G1 long-distance race similar to the Arima or a medium-distance G1 race.
choice_data_list: The Takarazuka Kinen and the autumn Tenno Sho…

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Then I'll run in those. I'll run as fast as I can… and get even better.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I feel like that's what I have to do.
